title: Adaptive representation memory and build-cost characterization
question: What memory and one-time construction cost would a run-lifetime registry of unique adaptive hydraulic representations impose at MultiSWAP scale?

workload.construction: deterministic small perturbations around B01, B12, O05 and O14 default-MvG authorities
workload.purpose: implementation-scale characterization, not a soil-population distribution claim

measurements: payload bytes per representation for x,z,dzdx,logk arrays
mean and median build CPU per unique representation
projected payload for 10000 unique representations using observed mean and maximum payload

accounting_scope.excluded_memory: Fortran allocatable descriptors, cache keys and container metadata, which are small fixed overheads relative to array payload
accounting_scope.included_time: adaptive table construction from initialized authoritative provider
accounting_scope.excluded_time: input parsing and full application setup

decision: Characterization only. F-AHL32 will preregister a registry/capacity policy after these measurements; no capacity or memory threshold is chosen post hoc inside F-AHL31.
